sectors.trend: Dominant rally driver; AMD $1T, Meta Muse AI, Nvidia pushback on doomsday talk, data center stocks surging on Trump-Xi AI dialogue
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle accelerating; hyperscaler adoption of solid-oxide fuel cells (Bloom Energy) and data center demand (SiTime, Credo) signal multi-year infrastructure buildout. However, 1999-style concentration risk flagged by CNBC.

sectors.trend: Crude slipping on Saudi pipeline fix and Trump UN speech; diesel shortage structural through 2027; oil inventories declining
sectors.implications: Near-term oil weakness supports equity rally but diesel scarcity creates supply-chain cost pressure. Yemen escalation adds tail risk. Aviation stocks (BoA buy call) benefit from lower fuel costs.

sectors.trend: Copper nears record on China supply tightness; silver at highs; gold steady on record Chinese imports; Fed hawkishness tempers precious metals
sectors.implications: Copper/silver strength signals industrial demand and China stimulus expectations. Gold's resilience via Chinese central bank buying provides portfolio hedge. Fed rate hike creates headwind for non-yielding assets.

sectors.trend: Sysco $17B bond offering oversubscribed; SoftBank $11B for OpenAI; Qatar-JPMorgan $20B; Apollo private credit fund capped at 14.7% exit; CFTC regulates prediction markets
sectors.implications: Robust capital markets activity; private credit and prediction markets expanding. Fed rate hike increases borrowing costs, pressuring high-debt names like CoreWeave ($51B debt).

market_outlook.short_term: Tech-led rally likely continues into U.S.-China talks this week, supported by falling oil and yields. However, CNBC's 1999-style concentration warning and Fed rate hike create volatility risk. Bitcoin at $85K and AMD at $1T signal euphoria—expect pullback risk within 2-3 weeks. Paramount-Warner settlement provides media sector catalyst. Monitor diesel shortage headlines for energy volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure buildout (data centers, power, semiconductors) remains primary 12-month theme. Energy transition (RWE batteries, Bloom Energy, Schneider Electric) provides structural growth. Asia inflation into 2027 constrains EM central bank easing. U.S.-China trade normalization could unlock copper/industrial demand. Social Security 2027 boost and pension reform debate support consumer/healthcare. Diesel shortage through 2027 keeps energy infrastructure relevant.
